name: Nishiaraidaishi-Nishi
tagline: Otemachi in 36 minutes and Tokyo in 37 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Adachi City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 36 minutes to Otemachi, 48 minutes to Shinjuku, 53 minutes to Shibuya and 51 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 2.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.3 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 2.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.1 m to 3.4 m, a difference of 1.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 8 clinics and 5 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東京女子医科大学附属足立医療センター, about 15 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 米倉脊椎・関節病院, about 23 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Nippori-Toneri Liner.
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Nippori-Toneri Liner. It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 2LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, a large projected flood depth and only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Yazaike is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Nishiaraidaishi-Nishi is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishiaraidaishi-Nishi. It is served by the same lines as Nishiaraidaishi-Nishi. To Toranomon, for instance, Yazaike takes 3 minutes longer. On how easy the shopping is, Nishiaraidaishi-Nishi comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.

noiseSources: 尾久橋通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Nippori-Toneri Liner serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
